content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get 13C NMR. That may be cheaper than IR? Both are similar cost. Probably carbon NMR gives carbonyl signals. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
